items.title: Cotton Dust Sheets and tarpaulin suppliers throughout the UK
items.body: If you are looking for high-quality and durable tarpaulin covers, dust sheets, sacks and bags, paint brushes and more; look no further than Tristar UK Ltd. All our products are directly sourced from Europe, India and the Far East; and we ensure all they are all of superior quality.

items.title: Experienced
items.body: Tristar are leading tool suppliers in Stevenage with almost 30 years of industry knowledge and experience we can help you find the perfect equipment and tools for your project. We stock a fully comprehensive range of tarpaulin, dust sheets and decorating accessories in a range of thickness and sizes. We have a wide variety and can help you find the most suitable products for your projects. Whether it be keeping your goods dry, protection against harsh weathers, or covering furniture while decorating we have it all. We also stock a wide range of sacks and bags including heavy duty rubble sacks and bin liners, wheelie bins liners; and paint brushes and rollers and painting supplies and equipment.
